purpose: Dedicated Chromium integration: actual HTTP media delivery, native decode/playback, independent ZIP, mobile layout, game resilience and HRTF distance attenuation.
qualityScope: Technical verification only; no subjective listening score or claim about arbitrary games.

checks.name: delivery page does not load Tone.js or a generator runtime
native browser codec probe and explicit delivery-plan review
checks.detail: 真实解码通过：opus-ogg → aac-lc-m4a。探针只解码，不播放。

checks.name: fresh service delivers hashed Opus/AAC media and browser decodes all selected files
short effects become locally usable before the complete music delivery
real click unlocks native Web Audio and three synchronized stems produce nonzero output
offline local playback, semantic events, pause/resume, mute and intensity make zero requests
mobile layout fits a 390 px viewport with a usable play control
actual ZIP download has a readable directory and valid CRCs for every file
exported standalone runtime loads only local files and plays offline without Tone or the service
real HRTF PannerNode reduces the same delivered SFX at ten metres

detail.scope: Native OfflineAudioContext plus the actual package player and HRTF PannerNode. Distance attenuation only; no Three.js scene or occlusion claim.

checks.name: a genuine failed service response leaves the fixed game responsive
final disposal releases native sources and stops the runtime

plan.decoderProbe: 真实解码通过：opus-ogg → aac-lc-m4a。探针只解码，不播放。

delivery.status: 已选声音全部制作完成，并可独立交付。

budget.measurement: Actual encoded and provenance file bytes; actual decoded Float32 frames. Manifest transport overhead is excluded.
